description: Check VAT status (VAT White List / Biała Lista) and KRS data for a Polish company by NIP. For entities without a KRS number (sole proprietors and civil partnerships, i.e. natural persons) personal data is limited (GDPR): the address is reduced to the town (the White List does not say whether it is a business or a home address), and bank accounts to their count — check a specific account with sprawdz_rachunek; no REGON number, registration date or PKD codes are returned for them (the ceidg field is always null). The privacy field lists what was hidden. White List data for entities with a KRS number may come from a same-day cache: then mfCached is true and bl.mfRequestDateTime is the time of the original Ministry query. If the full White List refuses the query (Ministry limit), the result may be status-only (source: status-only): bl is null and vatStatus has only the VAT status from the Ministry's API2, without name, address or bank accounts.
name: sprawdz_nip
